statement: The recorded value is not safe or correct to approve because Tomas cancelled the Fitline membership in writing on 3 July and Fitline confirmed the cancellation.
judge_text:
WRONG

It asserts "The recorded value is not safe or correct to approve because Tomas cancelled the Fitline membership in writing on 3 July and Fitline confirmed the cancellation," directly contradicting the record's "active, renewing" status.
